input.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted the sole-and-exclusive provider commitment in Section 2.2: we cannot accept exclusivity or field-of-use restrictions on the services we buy or build, and the clause directly contradicts Section 12.3, under which we make no exclusivity or non-compete commitment. If Silverline needs some protection, we could discuss a narrow alternative limited to a single named competing product during the term only (maximum twelve months), with carve-outs for our internal development and acquisitions.
input.summary: Delete Section 2.2 exclusivity commitment binding Customer.
